text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Etobicoke York Community Council to convert Rutherford Avenue and Victoria Boulevard from a "Street Specific" to a "Area based" Permit Parking program, within the newly created "15A" permit area. Transportation Services recommends approval of this proposal as it will allow greater parking flexibility for residents.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on February 14, 2019.
